subject: Coordination: demo + contract redline meeting (AtlasCloud)

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo & initial contract

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had a quick alignment with procurement and legal — they'd like to do a combined session next week to walk through your live demo and go line-by-line on the contract redlines we circulated.

Attached is a PDF with the initial redlines (AtlasCloud_Redlines_v1.pdf). Procurement wants the commercial points (term, termination, data handling) in scope, and security wants to confirm the data flow and SOC2 artifacts.

Can we do a 60-minute working session next Wed or Thu (PST) that includes: AE + SE + our procurement lead + legal + security? If you can share a few time windows, we'll lock one.

Also, please copy your legal/procurement on the invite so we can have the right decision-makers.

Thanks,
Jordan

j.ellis@atlascloud.com

Jordan — thanks for sending the redlines and for the clear scope. We can absolutely run a combined session. High-level proposal: 60-minute joint session to go through the high-priority redlines (commercial + data handling), followed by an optional 30-minute technical deep-dive with our SEs if you want tokenization/latency/segmentation detail.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 2026-09-02 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-09-02 13:00–14:00
- Thu 2026-09-03 10:30–11:30

Agenda (draft):
1) 5m — objective, attendees, scope (Marissa)
2) 30–35m — contract redlines (legal + procurement)
3) 15–20m — product/tech implications (Rishi + SE team)
4) 5–10m — next steps (DocuSign readiness, target signature timelines)

Action items before the meeting:
- Procurement/legal to highlight critical clauses (Jordan)
- AtlasCloud to share SOC2 or list of specific evidence requests to security-ops@redwood.com
- We will circulate a SOW tracker and a short redline summary ahead of time (see attachments).

If any of the proposed times work, I'll send a calendar invite and include the attachments: AtlasCloud_SOW_tracker.xlsx and redline_summary.md.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — I can join the full 60 minutes but propose we keep the product section tight and do a 20–30 min technical follow-up for AtlasCloud engineers. Quick notes for Jordan/procurement/security:
- For the redlines that touch data handling, please flag the exact clause numbers so we can map them to our data flow diagram.
- If AtlasCloud needs token-level retention controls or custom logging, please include that as an explicit ask in the pre-read — otherwise we'll cover standard retention/KV cache behavior.
- Typical slot I can do: Wed 09:00–10:30 (so I can stay for the product deep-dive), or Thu 10:00–11:30 if that helps.

If you want a separate 30-min engineering-only session, happy to set that up the same week.

Appreciate the context — putting legal on this thread. A few quick asks from our side so we can be efficient on the call:
- Please send the PDF with inline redline comments (we received the PDF but inline comments are easier). If you prefer, a Word/track-changes version helps speed review.
- Highlight the top 5 commercial clauses you expect to negotiate today (term, termination, data residency, indemnity, liability cap).
- Procurement should confirm decision authority for signature on the call so we know whether the meeting is negotiating or just clarifying.

I'll prepare a 2-page redline summary and will attach it to the invite. If you want to accelerate execution, please send the preferred counters you want us to consider before the meeting.

Regards,

soojin_lee@redwood.com
